idea-plugin.name: Vue Script Setup Creator
idea-plugin.description:
Detects variables and methods that are used inside the <template> block of a Vue 3 single file component but are never defined.

When the mouse is moved over such an identifier the quick fixes 创建变量 (create variable) and 创建方法 (create method) are offered. Both of them add the new binding to the <script setup> block of the component, the block is created automatically when it does not exist yet.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Detects undefined variables and methods in Vue 3 templates.
  • Quick fixes “创建变量” / “创建方法” create the binding inside <script setup>.
